nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands that let the frontend start, stop, pause, resume, and query the status of the agent browser automation controller, emitting `browser:status` events to keep the UI in sync.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel that exposes the browser automation Tauri command surface and re-exports `AgentBrowserController` from the shared_state crate for use by frontend commands and agent tools.

nodes.name: capture.rs
nodes.summary: Captures the visible contents of an inline webview as a PNG data URL for attaching to chat inputs, using WKWebView's native snapshot API on macOS.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses objc2/block2 FFI to call Cocoa's WKWebView snapshot API directly from Rust, wrapping the async Objective-C completion handler in an mpsc channel.

nodes.name: cookies.rs
nodes.summary: Provides native, platform-specific cookie access (including HttpOnly cookies invisible to JavaScript) via WKHTTPCookieStore and NSHTTPCookieStorage on macOS.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unsafe Objective-C interop via objc2 to bridge WKWebView/NSHTTPCookieStorage APIs that have no native Rust equivalent.

nodes.name: dom_editor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CRUD-style DOM editing commands (insert, delete, update, clone, move) plus undo/redo history and multi-element selection for inline webviews, enabling a visual DOM-based design editor.

nodes.name: inline.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the lifecycle of inline webviews embedded in the main application window -- creation, positioning, visibility, navigation, and teardown -- using a generation/ref-count scheme to guard against races from rapid create/close cycles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a per-label 'generation' counter plus reference counting to cancel stale async webview-creation tasks when a newer request for the same label arrives, preventing race conditions during rapid navigation.

nodes.name: internal_browser_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Exposes the `window.__PAGE_AGENT__` DOM-automation API injected into inline webviews as direct Tauri commands, letting the frontend click, type, select, and scroll within a webview for testing and debugging.

nodes.name: emit_browser_status
nodes.summary: Emits a `browser:status` Tauri event to the frontend with the current automation status, port, and optional error.

nodes.name: browser_automation_start
nodes.summary: Tauri command that starts the browser automation controller on the selected backend and emits status events as it launches.

nodes.name: browser_automation_stop
nodes.summary: Tauri command that stops the running browser automation controller and emits a stopped status event.

nodes.name: browser_automation_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current running/paused state, port, and URL of the browser automation controller.

nodes.name: browser_automation_takeover
nodes.summary: Tauri command that pauses agent-driven automation so the user can manually take over the browser.

nodes.name: browser_screenshot_get
nodes.summary: Tauri command that retrieves a stored screenshot by id from the shared screenshot store.

nodes.name: browser_automation_resume
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resumes agent-driven automation after a user takeover, restoring automated control of the browser.

nodes.name: BrowserAutomationStatus
nodes.summary: Serializable status payload (running, paused, port, current URL) returned by the browser automation status command.

nodes.name: browser_inline_capture
nodes.summary: Tauri command that captures a PNG snapshot of the named inline webview and returns it as a base64 data URL.

nodes.name: take_snapshot_macos
nodes.summary: macOS-only implementation that uses WKWebView's takeSnapshot Objective-C API via unsafe FFI to render the webview's visible viewport into a PNG buffer.

nodes.name: get_webview_cookies
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns all cookies visible to a given webview, optionally filtered by URL, using platform-native cookie stores.

nodes.name: get_wkwebview_cookies
nodes.summary: macOS implementation that reads cookies directly from a WKWebView's WKHTTPCookieStore via Objective-C runtime calls, including HttpOnly cookies.

nodes.name: get_macos_shared_cookies
nodes.summary: Falls back to the system-wide NSHTTPCookieStorage to retrieve cookies shared across all webviews on macOS.

nodes.name: parse_cookie
nodes.summary: Parses a raw Objective-C NSHTTPCookie object into the crate's `CookieInfo` struct.

nodes.name: matches_domain
nodes.summary: Checks whether a cookie's domain matches an optional domain filter string.

nodes.name: nsstring_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a raw Objective-C NSString pointer into an owned Rust String.

nodes.name: insert_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inserts a new DOM element with the given tag and attributes at a position relative to a parent element located by XPath.

nodes.name: insert_html
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inserts raw HTML at a position relative to a parent element located by XPath.

nodes.name: delete_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes the DOM element matched by XPath from the webview.

nodes.name: update_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that updates the attributes of a DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: clone_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that duplicates a DOM element matched by XPath, optionally performing a deep clone of its children.

nodes.name: move_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that relocates a DOM element to a new position relative to a target element.

nodes.name: undo_dom_operation
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reverts the most recent DOM edit for a webview using its operation history.

nodes.name: redo_dom_operation
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reapplies the most recently undone DOM edit for a webview.

nodes.name: HistoryState
nodes.summary: Serializable payload describing undo/redo availability and counts for a webview's DOM edit history.

nodes.name: get_dom_history_state
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reports how many undo/redo operations are available for a webview's DOM edit history.

nodes.name: serialize_dom_to_html
nodes.summary: Tauri command that serializes the current DOM (or a subtree rooted at an XPath) of a webview back to an HTML string.

nodes.name: multi_select_add
nodes.summary: Tauri command that adds an element to the active multi-element selection set.

nodes.name: multi_select_remove
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes an element from the active multi-element selection set.

nodes.name: multi_select_toggle
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles an element's membership in the active multi-element selection set.

nodes.name: get_multi_selection
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the XPaths currently in the multi-element selection set.

nodes.name: clear_multi_selection
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clears the active multi-element selection set.

nodes.name: ElementBounds
nodes.summary: Serializable bounding-box payload (position and edges) for a DOM element.

nodes.name: get_element_bounds
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the bounding rectangle of a DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: get_multiple_bounds
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns bounding rectangles for multiple DOM elements matched by their XPaths.

nodes.name: resize_element
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the width and height of a DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: set_element_position
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the x/y position of a DOM element matched by XPath.

nodes.name: save_html_to_file
nodes.summary: Tauri command that serializes the DOM (or a subtree) to HTML and writes it to disk, optionally prefixing a doctype declaration.

nodes.name: get_full_html_document
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the full serialized HTML document of a webview.

nodes.name: frame_from_corners
nodes.summary: Computes a normalized x/y/width/height frame from two opposite corner points.

nodes.name: set_generation
nodes.summary: Records the current generation counter for a webview label, used to detect and cancel stale creation requests.

nodes.name: cancel_generation
nodes.summary: Marks a specific generation of a webview label as cancelled so in-flight creation work can abort early.

nodes.name: is_current_generation
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given generation number is still the latest generation recorded for a webview label.

nodes.name: decrement_ref
nodes.summary: Decrements the reference count for a webview label, removing bookkeeping once it reaches zero.

nodes.name: create_inline_webview
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates (or reuses) an inline webview at a given position within the parent window, applying generation/ref-count guards so only the latest request for a label wins.

nodes.name: update_inline_webview_position
nodes.summary: Tauri command that repositions and resizes an existing inline webview.

nodes.name: set_inline_webview_visibility
nodes.summary: Tauri command that shows or hides an inline webview without destroying it.

nodes.name: reposition_and_show_webview
nodes.summary: Tauri command that repositions an inline webview and ensures it is visible in a single call.

nodes.name: close_inline_webview
nodes.summary: Tauri command that tears down an inline webview for a label, guarded by generation checks so it does not close a webview recreated after the close was requested.

nodes.name: hide_all_inline_webviews
nodes.summary: Tauri command that hides every currently tracked inline webview, typically when a full-screen overlay takes focus.

nodes.name: close_all_inline_webviews
nodes.summary: Tauri command that closes every currently tracked inline webview, clearing all generation and ref-count bookkeeping.

nodes.name: navigate_inline_webview
nodes.summary: Tauri command that navigates an existing inline webview to a new URL.

nodes.name: reload_inline_webview
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reloads the current page in an existing inline webview.

nodes.name: eval_browser_call
nodes.summary: Evaluates a JavaScript expression against the injected browser automation bridge in a webview and deserializes the JSON result, retrying while the page agent script loads.

nodes.name: eval_page_agent_call
nodes.summary: Evaluates a call against the injected `__PAGE_AGENT__` object, returning a fallback value if the script has not yet initialized.

nodes.name: InternalBrowserState
nodes.summary: Serializable snapshot of an internal browser webview's page state (URL, title, header/content/footer HTML).

nodes.name: InternalBrowserActionResult
nodes.summary: Serializable success/message result payload returned by internal browser action commands.

nodes.name: InternalBrowserLocation
nodes.summary: Serializable URL/title payload for an internal browser webview's current location.

nodes.name: internal_browser_get_state
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current page state (URL, title, header/content/footer HTML) of an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_get_location
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current URL and title of an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_click
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clicks the element at a given index in an internal browser webview via the injected page agent.

nodes.name: internal_browser_input
nodes.summary: Tauri command that types text into the element at a given index in an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_select
nodes.summary: Tauri command that selects an option in a dropdown element at a given index in an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_scroll
nodes.summary: Tauri command that scrolls an internal browser webview by a number of pages in a given direction, optionally targeting a specific element.

nodes.name: internal_browser_show_mask
nodes.summary: Tauri command that shows the visual overlay mask used to indicate automated interaction on an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_hide_mask
nodes.summary: Tauri command that hides the visual overlay mask on an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_clean_up
nodes.summary: Tauri command that cleans up injected automation state in an internal browser webview.

nodes.name: internal_browser_is_ready
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reports whether the injected page agent script has finished initializing in an internal browser webview.
